description: This PHP source file defines a Config class for parsing, editing, and managing configuration data sources, including registration of configuration types and container management.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class that provides methods for parsing configuration datasources, managing configuration types, and handling configuration containers.

methods.name: __construct

methods.name: registerConfigType

methods.name: parseConfig
